test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The area of a circular park is 1386 m². If a path of the width 7 m is laid around and inside the park. Then the area of the path is:
solution:
**Given:**

The area of a circular park = 1386 m²

A path of the width = 7 m

**Formula used:**

Area of circle = πr²

**Calculation:**

According to the question

Area of circle = πr²

⇒ 22/7 × r² = 1386 m²

⇒ 22r²/7 = 1386

⇒ r²/7 = 63

⇒ r² = 441 

⇒ r = 21 m

Now,

Area of path = Area of larger circular park – Area of smaller circular park

⇒ 1386 – π(r – 7)²

⇒ 1386 – π(21 – 7)²

⇒ 1386 – π(14)²

⇒ 1386 – π(196)

⇒ 1386 – (22/7 × 196)

⇒ (1386 – 616) m²

⇒ 770 m²

**∴ The required area of the path is 770 m²**
